name: Nisus Finance Services Co Ltd
tagline: Small-cap transaction-advisory, fund-management and SME-credit business riding India's private-credit/AIF boom - strong ROE/ROCE and near-zero debt, but recent 118% YoY revenue growth is largely acquisition-driven, tempering the compounding-math case.
business_overview: Nisus Finance Services (NSE: NISUS) specialises in transaction advisory services, fund management (alternative investment funds / private credit) and SME credit services, operating as a small-cap financial-services platform. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@ChintanParikh10), bullish, medium conviction.
fundamentals_narrative: A genuinely attractive quality profile on the surface: high ROE (~20%) and ROCE (~25.6%), near-zero leverage (D/E ~0.06), and headline revenue growth of 118% YoY. The important caveat, from the same source, is that the growth is 'largely attributed to strategic acquisitions' rather than pure organic scaling - which matters for a compounding thesis, since acquisition-driven growth carries integration risk and is less mechanically repeatable than organic AUM/fee growth. The business itself (transaction advisory + AIF/private-credit fund management + SME credit) sits inside a real, large India-specific tailwind: the rapid growth of the domestic alternative-investment-fund and private-credit industry and the well-documented SME credit gap.
